newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wyndham Hotel cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wyndham Hotel cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Wyndham Hotel Corp to hold from buy.
-- cited unconfirmed media reports that Wyndham Hotel and Patriot American Hospitality Inc were in merger talks.
-- said that at current price levels, Wyndham is fully valued for the near-term.
-- said patient investors can expect a five to seven percent compound growth rate in the stock over two to three years.
